seo.title: How to Publish Manga on MangaGreen — A Guide for Authors
seo.description: Here's how to get your manga or manhwa live on MangaGreen, step by step: from signing up to your first chapter in the catalog — no red tape involved.

publishGuide.heading: How to publish your manga on MangaGreen
publishGuide.intro: Want to upload your manga, manhwa or comic for readers to find? MangaGreen is a free manga-reading site with a section for original, independently published work. Anyone can publish — no publisher, no portfolio, no fee.
publishGuide.step1Text: Sign up with an email and password, or with Google — takes under a minute.
publishGuide.step2Text: Go to your creator studio and start a new work: title, description, genres and a cover image.
publishGuide.step3Text: Add chapters page by page (JPEG, PNG or WebP). You can prepare several chapters at once and add more any time, even after publishing.
publishGuide.step4Title: 4. Submit for review, then you're live
publishGuide.step4Text: Submit your work for a quick moderation check. Once approved, it appears in the Originals catalog for every visitor to read.
publishGuide.benefit1: Completely free — no fees, no paywalled uploads.
publishGuide.benefit2: You keep every right to your work — MangaGreen only hosts it for readers.
publishGuide.benefit3: A public author profile with a follower count and read stats.
publishGuide.benefit4: Add links to your other social profiles and donation pages.
publishGuide.ctaSecondary: Want the bigger picture first? Read what it's like to be an author here.

seo.title: Become an Author on MangaGreen — Publish Manga Free
seo.description: No publisher, no portfolio, no experience needed — just upload your manga, manhwa or comic and start finding readers. We're already home to stories you won't find anywhere else.

becomeAuthor.heading: Where to publish your manga or manhwa — no publisher required
becomeAuthor.intro: Looking for somewhere to publish your manga, manhwa or comic? MangaGreen's Originals section is a free platform where independent authors upload their work directly and reach real readers — no publishing deal, no agent, no years of experience needed.
becomeAuthor.who1: You've finished (or are working on) a manga, manhwa or comic and have nowhere to publish it.
becomeAuthor.who2: You want real readers and feedback, not just a folder of files.
becomeAuthor.who3: You'd rather keep full ownership of your work than sign it away to a publisher.
becomeAuthor.whatYouGetHeading: What you get as an author
becomeAuthor.get1: A public author profile — followers, total reads, and your published works in one place.
becomeAuthor.get2: Full ownership of your work, always — MangaGreen never takes any rights over what you publish.
becomeAuthor.get3: Links to your social media and donation pages, right on your profile.
becomeAuthor.get4: Room to grow alongside the platform and its readers, from your very first chapter.
becomeAuthor.communityNote: MangaGreen already hosts original work from a number of independent authors — you'd be joining an existing, growing catalog, not starting from zero.
becomeAuthor.ctaHeading: Ready to publish your first chapter?
becomeAuthor.ctaSecondary: Prefer a step-by-step walkthrough first? See exactly how publishing works.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.draftNotice: This is a draft written in plain language to honestly explain what the site actually does — it is not a final legal document. If the site's audience starts to grow, it should be reviewed by a lawyer before official publication.
terms.s1p1: By publishing a title in the Originals section, the author does not transfer any rights to their work to MangaGreen — neither copyright, nor exclusive rights, nor any others. All rights remain with the author.
terms.s1p2: MangaGreen only hosts the uploaded pages on its server so that visitors can read them — and does nothing else with them: it doesn't pass them to third parties, sell them, or use them for other purposes.
terms.s1p3: By publishing a work, the author confirms they hold the rights to it (see the <rulesLink>publishing rules</rulesLink> for details).
terms.s2Title: 2. The right to delete or edit a publication
terms.s2p1: An author can delete their work (with all its chapters) at any time from the author studio — whether it's a draft, under moderation, or already published. Deletion is irreversible: the pages are erased from the server.
terms.s2p2: The title, description, cover and genres can be edited while the work is not yet published (a draft, or rejected by a moderator) — this prevents the content being quietly swapped under an already approved title. New chapters can be added at any time, even after publication.
terms.s2p3: If you need to edit an already published work in a way other than adding chapters — write to us via the contacts in the side panel and we'll do it manually.
terms.s3text: In short: when you register we store your email, name and password (as a hash — we neither store nor see the password itself). If you publish works, an author profile is also created — optionally with an avatar and links to social networks/donations. Reading progress and your favorites list are stored separately so they can be synced between devices. A detailed description is on the <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink> page.
terms.s4Title: 4. General terms of using the site
terms.s4p1: The MangaDex content catalog is available without registration — an account is only needed to save progress/favorites across devices and to publish your own works.
terms.s4p2: Using the site to distribute content that violates the law or the rights of third parties is prohibited — see the <rulesLink>publishing rules</rulesLink> for the detailed list.
terms.s4p3: The administration may remove content that violates the rules without notice and block the offender's account.
terms.s4p4: The site is provided “as is” — we try to keep everything running reliably but don't guarantee uninterrupted operation (including because the MangaDex catalog is loaded directly from an external API — see the section on third-party services in the <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink>).
terms.s4p5: We may change these terms — significant changes will be reflected in the update date at the top of the page.
terms.contactNote: Questions about this agreement — via the contacts in the site's side panel.

rules.title: Publishing Rules
rules.s1p1: Only original content created by the author themselves may be published.
rules.s1p2: Publishing other people's work without the explicit permission of the rights holder is prohibited.
rules.s1p3: Passing off someone else's content as your own (plagiarism) is prohibited.
rules.s1p4: If a violation is found, the title is removed and the author may be blocked.
rules.s2p1: 18+ content (erotica, pornography, graphic violence) is completely prohibited on the platform.
rules.s2p2: Content must be appropriate for a wide audience of readers.
rules.s3p1: Incitement of hatred, discrimination on any grounds.
rules.s4p1: By publishing a work, the author confirms they hold the rights to it.
rules.s4p2: The author is responsible for the content of their publication.
rules.s4p3: The administration reserves the right to remove content that violates the rules without prior notice.
rules.s5p1: All new publications may be reviewed by the administration before appearing in the catalog.
rules.s5p2: Complaints from readers are reviewed within a reasonable time.
rules.contactNote: Questions about these rules — via the contacts in the site footer.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.whatText: This is a short, plain-language summary of how MangaGreen handles data — not a full legal document yet. If you have questions, reach out through the contacts in the footer.
privacy.accountText: If you create an account, we store your name, email, and a hashed password (or a Google account identifier if you sign in with Google — we never see your Google password). This is used only to let you log in and sync your favorites and reading progress across devices.
privacy.readingText: If you're logged in, your favorites and reading progress (title, chapter, page number) are stored on our server. If you're not logged in, the same data is kept only in your browser's local storage and never leaves your device.
privacy.cookiesText: We use local storage (not tracking cookies) to remember your login session, language, theme, and — for guests — favorites and reading progress. We don't use this data for advertising or share it with ad networks.
privacy.thirdText: Manga metadata, covers, and pages are loaded live from <mdLink>MangaDex</mdLink>. If you use Google Sign-In, Google processes your login on their side — see Google's own privacy policy for that part.
privacy.choicesText: You can use MangaGreen without an account. If you have an account and want your data deleted, contact us through the footer links.
